messages:
leah: Quick note 1 opened a small PR to fix the cost widget example in console docs. It was pointing to the legacy metric name and the dashboard variable names didn't match live UI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301
omar: Thanks. Which metric name changed? I remember a rename last quarter.
leah: Yeah, `request_tokens_total` -> `tokens_generated_total`. Also tweaked the example query to include streaming vs non-streaming breakdown. Tiny snippet included.
raph: Can you paste the example query here so I can sanity-check the group-by?
leah: Sure:
```sql
SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens, mode
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE model = 'open-runtime/redwood-v2' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY mode
ORDER BY tokens DESC
```
omar: Nice. Add a note that `mode` can be "streaming" or "non-streaming" and that streaming may show lower billed tokens for short responses.
leah: Added that. I also fixed two internal links that CI flagged.
ci-bot: CI: link-check failed on /console/metrics -> replaced with /console/metrics/overview
docs-bot: CI: spellcheck & build OK 705
raph: LGTM. Suggest a one-line migration note at top: "If you used the old metric name, update dashboards before the 2026-04-01 cutover."
leah: Added migration note + small screenshot that highlights the variable selector. Planning to merge after another quick review.
omar: Thumbs up from me.
